title: The HUD's one goal line on the ask morning, with the fund in the bag
about: Spring 6, 07:00 on the farm: the spring was asked today and the purse and bag hold its fund, while the goal chain has a goal of its own. The line reads the ask first ("Rosa asked: the Old Spring"); tomorrow it would read "Old Spring: ready to fund"; with no valley step the goal shows. Menu > Goal lists THE VALLEY above the goals; the goal arrow points at Ilse's gate.
